question: Carnatic singer Bombay Jayashri has been selected for which music award in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangita Kalanidhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The prestigious **Sangita Kalanidhi Award** is conferred by the Madras Music Academy, one of the most prominent institutions for Carnatic music.
 
• **Bombay Jayashri**, a renowned Carnatic vocalist, was selected for the Sangita Kalanidhi award in 2023 for her immense contributions to the field of classical music.
 
• The award is regarded as one of the highest honors in the world of Carnatic music and is given annually to a distinguished musician.
 
• Bombay Jayashri is celebrated for her melodious voice, innovative approach to music, and her efforts to popularize Carnatic music globally.
 
• The award ceremony is traditionally held during the Madras Music Academy's annual Margazhi festival in Chennai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bombay Jayashri:**

 
 
• She is a Padma Shri awardee and has an illustrious career spanning over decades in Carnatic music and film music.
 
• Her works include collaborations with musicians from various genres, including Hindustani music and global classical traditions.
 
• She is also known for her playback singing, having contributed to films like the Oscar-winning "Life of Pi."
 
• Her efforts include spreading awareness about Indian classical music through workshops, lectures, and performances worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Madras Music Academy:**
 
 
• It is one of the most prestigious institutions for promoting Carnatic music and culture, established in 1928.
 
• The Sangita Kalanidhi award was instituted in 1942 and is given to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to Carnatic music.
 
• The academy conducts the annual Margazhi music festival, a significant cultural event in Chennai, attracting artists and audiences globally.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• Carnatic music is a classical music tradition of South India, characterized by its complex compositions and improvisational elements.
 
• Key components include ragas (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic cycles).
 
• It is traditionally performed in a kutcheri (concert) format, with vocalists often accompanied by instruments such as the violin, mridangam, and tambura.
 
 
 
• **Other Awards in Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• Sangeetha Choodamani: Awarded by Sri Krishna Gana Sabha for excellence in Carnatic music.
 
• Sangeetha Kalasarathy: Presented by Parthasarathy Swami Sabha for outstanding contributions to music.
 
• Sangeetha Kalasikhamani: Conferred by The Indian Fine Arts Society for lifetime achievements in music.
